title: Normalized scalar coefficient transports and canonical whole-tower comparison maps
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in one universe, and a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding $\iota:E\to L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$ use the derived module categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the completed coefficient rings $R_{E,W},R_{L,W}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], their quotient-normalized identity transports $I_E,I_L$ [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum], and ordinary scalar extension $C_W=-\otimes_{R_{E,W}}R_{L,W}$ with its derived functor $C_W^D$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Write $C_W^p$ for the ordinary PBC scalar extension, and use its derived ambient tensor functor and actual completed-pullback scalar comparison [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].
A normalized scalar coefficient transport is a tuple, asserting no existence, consisting of a module natural isomorphism $c_W^0:I_L C_W\simeq C_W^p I_E$ whose value on every sheafified tensor generator $s\otimes x$ is $r_L^{-1}(s)\otimes x$, where $r_L$ is the fixed coefficient-ring identity; and a derived natural isomorphism $c_W:I_L^D C_W^D\simeq (C_W^p)^D I_E^D$. For every cochain complex $P$, require that $c_W$ at $Q(P)$, followed by the PBC scalar image of the coefficient-transport localization comparison and then the actual PBC cochain counit, equals the image under $I_L^D$ of the ordinary-scalar localization comparison, followed by the coefficient-transport localization comparison at $C_W(P)$ and then $Q$ of the cochain map whose degree-$i$ component is $(c_W^0)_{P^i}$. Thus this is the specified universal cochain-counit normalization, not an arbitrary isomorphism of derived endpoints. The last cochain map is defined componentwise by $c_W^0$.
Use the derived sequence category and total limit $R\!\lim$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], and the constant-tower functor $\Delta$ with its actual adjunction counit $\epsilon:\Delta R\!\lim\to1$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Define $\widehat C_W$ to be the derived functor of termwise $C_W$ on whole strict towers. Define $\sigma_W:\widehat C_W\Delta_E\simeq\Delta_L C_W^D$ by deriving the literal ordinary constant-tower/scalar square, with the two derived-composition comparisons inserted. Define the canonical scalar/limit map $\lambda_Q:C_W^D(R\!\lim_E Q)\to R\!\lim_L(\widehat C_W Q)$ to be the adjunct of $\widehat C_W(\epsilon_{E,Q})\circ\sigma_{W,R\!\lim_E Q}^{-1}$. No basis or comparison is chosen.
For an isomorphism $h:U\simeq T$, supplied normalized transports $c_U,c_T$, a common strict-tower datum $b_E$ [def-fd-common-strict-tower-models], and an integral constructible $K$, define the actual PBC comparison with coefficient identities inserted to be
$$F^p_{h,L}(c_{T,K}^{-1})\circ(\delta^p_{I_EK})\circ (C_U^p)^D(b_{E,K}^{\rm amb})\circ c_{U,G_{h,E}K}.$$
Here $G_{h,E}$ is the ordinary framework derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], $F^p$ is the actual PBC completed pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and $\delta^p$ is the inverse-direction hom of the fixed completed-pullback/scalar isomorphism [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. This defines a map from $I_L^D C_U^D G_{h,E}K$ to $F^p_{h,L}I_L^D C_T^D K$. No commutative scalar/pullback square, existence of the supplied data, or invertibility of this composite is asserted.
